title: euphrasia arctica var. dolosa
intro: Euphrasia arctica var. dolosa, commonly known as Arctic Eyebright, is a variety of the Euphrasia arctica plant, a type of flowering plant in the gentian family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe and heal irritated eyes, skin, and mucous membranes. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia arctica var. dolosa include its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, as well as its potential to treat respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
